---
title: "EASI RNA-seq Analysis Report"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    theme: flatly
    code_folding: hide
params:
  prefix: "comparison"
---

```{r setup, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
prefix <- params$prefix
comparison <- gsub("_vs_", " vs ", prefix)

read_tsv_if_exists <- function(file) {
  if (file.exists(file)) {
    read.delim(
      file,
      sep = "\t",
      header = TRUE,
      check.names = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    NULL
  }
}

show_table <- function(df, n = 20) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    cat("No results available.")
  } else {
    knitr::kable(head(df, n))
  }
}

show_image <- function(file) {
  if (file.exists(file)) {
    knitr::include_graphics(file)
  } else {
    cat("File not available.")
  }
}

results <- read_tsv_if_exists(
  paste0(prefix, ".deseq2.results.tsv")
)

genes_tested <- if (!is.null(results)) {
  nrow(results)
} else {
  NA_integer_
}

significant_genes <- if (!is.null(results) && "padj" %in% colnames(results)) {
  sum(!is.na(results$padj) & results$padj < 0.05)
} else {
  NA_integer_
}
```

# Overview

```{r overview, echo=FALSE}
overview <- data.frame(
  Item = c(
    "Comparison",
    "Genes tested",
    "Significant genes (padj < 0.05)"
  ),
  Value = c(
    comparison,
    genes_tested,
    significant_genes
  )
)

knitr::kable(overview)
```

# Output files

```{r output-files, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
files <- list.files(
  pattern = paste0("^", prefix, "\\.")
)

if (length(files) == 0) {
  cat("No output files found.")
} else {
  cat("<ul>")
  
  for (f in files) {
    cat(sprintf(
      '<li><a href="%s" download>%s</a></li>',
      f,
      f
    ))
  }
  
  cat("</ul>")
}
```
